messages:
marie (acme-admin): Hey @support — since ~23:00 our users get 403 when SSOing via Okta. Only started after the cert rotation. Screenshot: https://acme.okta/err (we can share metadata)

jordan (support): Sorry about that, we're looking. Can you paste the IdP metadata URL and one example SAML response (base64) or an error from your browser devtools? Also which SP config (tenant id) are you using?

marie (acme-admin): metadata link: https://acme.okta/admin/app/0oa1234567/metadata.xml
SP tenant: acme-prod
Example server log from our side: "SAML response rejected: Signature validation failed: no matching signing key found (KeyDescriptor use=\"encryption\")"

samir (eng-sre): I pulled the metadata we fetched at 2026-06-03T23:05: our parser shows only a KeyDescriptor with use="encryption" for the new cert. The assertion is signed, but the metadata doesn't advertise a signing key. That will cause signature validation to fail.

cesar (identity): Reproduced locally with a copy of their metadata. Quick snippet from metadata we fetched:

```
<KeyDescriptor use="encryption">
  <KeyInfo>
    <X509Data>
      <X509Certificate>MIIF...NEW...CERT...</X509Certificate>
    </X509Data>
  </KeyInfo>
</KeyDescriptor>
<!-- no KeyDescriptor use="signing" present for that cert -->
```

samir (eng-sre): And here's the error from our SP logs when we try to validate the signature:

```
2026-06-03T23:12:41Z sp-auth ERROR saml: SignatureValidationException: No trusted signing key found for Signature KeyName="enc-key-2026" at ValidateSignature()
```

jordan (support): Sounds like Okta rotated and erroneously placed the cert in the encryption slot only. This matches prior cases where metadata generators accidentally mark the new key as encryption-only during rollouts.

marie (acme-admin): Okta support says they rotated keys automatically via a cert bundling job. They see both certs in their admin but one flagged as encryption. They can re-export metadata but need a quick workaround — we have many users blocked.

cesar (identity): Workarounds:
1) Have Okta re-export metadata and ensure the new cert appears under KeyDescriptor use="signing" (Okta admin -> Sign On -> View SAML setup -> Download metadata). Confirm <KeyDescriptor use="signing"> for the active signing cert.
2) If re-export not possible immediately, we can temporarily add the new cert to our SP truststore as an allowed signing cert (manual) so assertion verification succeeds. That requires a manual update and restart of the metadata-watcher.

samir (eng-sre): Steps for internal quick patch (if support approves):
- Fetch the raw certificate from customer's metadata (base64 DER)
- Add to keystore: /etc/redwood/sp-trust/acme-prod/new-rotated.pem
- kubectl -n redwood exec -it sp-auth-<pod> -- /bin/sh -c 'cp /etc/redwood/sp-trust/acme-prod/*.pem /app/trust && kill -HUP 1'
- Restart metadata watcher: `kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/sp-metadata-watcher`

jordan (support): Note: manual addition bypasses the intended metadata semantics. We should only do it with explicit customer approval and rotate it out once IdP fixes metadata.

marie (acme-admin): Approving manual patch for a short window. Please proceed and I'll keep Okta on the line to fix metadata permanently.

samir (eng-sre): Patch applied to one replica. Confirming reduced 403s in logs now. Still watching for session edgecases (some clients cached old relaystate). Observability: token acceptance rate climbed from 0%->72% for acme-prod within 2 min.

cesar (identity): Follow-up actions:
- [ ] Ask Okta to re-publish metadata with signing KeyDescriptor for the rotated cert.
- [ ] After Okta confirms, revert manual keystore change and restart watchers.
- [ ] Add a check in our metadata-watcher: emit a WARNING when fetched metadata has signing KeyDescriptor missing but assertion signature present.

jordan (support): I'll create a short KB note for support: 'Intermittent SSO failures after IdP rotation when cert is only published as encryption key' and link to the manual remediation steps.

marie (acme-admin): Okta just confirmed they'll re-export metadata and push it to their app. ETA 15m. Thanks for the fast patch, team :pray:

okta-bot: OKTA ADMIN NOTIFICATION: Metadata re-export complete for app 0oa1234567 at 2026-06-03T23:28:10Z

samir (eng-sre): Re-downloaded metadata and now see signing KeyDescriptor present. Rolling back manual keystore change and restarting watcher.

samir (eng-sre): Post-rollback check: 200/200 recent log assertions validated. Closing incident but leaving follow up ticket for metadata-watcher enhancement.

marie (acme-admin): Confirmed users can login again. Thanks everyone. Will update Okta process to ensure the signing descriptor is set during rotation.

jordan (support): Great — closing thread, will file the KB and the watcher enhancement ticket.
